questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bags are pants.

All pants are eggs.

All eggs are flowers.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pants are flowers.

II. All pants are bags.

III. All flowers are bags.

IV. All flowers are pants
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78591c58844fc9e5ca03abdde27136def7c263a2840617ff70f0ab2f6ddb2ad6.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pants are flowers → Follow (As all pants are eggs and all eggs are flowers. As whole plants comes in eggs which whole comes in flowers, therefore it is true.)

II. All pants are bags → **Does not** follow (As all bags are pants. So it is possible but not definite.)

III. All flowers are bags → Does not follow (As all bags are pants, all pants are eggs and all eggs are flowers. So it is possible but not definite.)

IV. All flowers are pants → Does not follow (As all pants are eggs and all eggs are flowers. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: Six people, S, T, U, V, W and X, are sitting in a straight row facing north. Only two people sit to the left of U. Only two people sit between U and X. T sits to the immediate right of S. W sits to the immediate left of V. V is not a neighbour of X. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Six people, S, T, U, V, W and X, are sitting in a straight row facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the left of U.

2) Only two people sit between U and X. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a442bee4499488ffea0b68c5b797d47209b6bac659f3e7c9f9b77a1e84c8ca8.png] 

3) W sits to the immediate left of V.

4) V is not a neighbour of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/507342c481d67d5ac1eb7614ea1f504aa70338c220145b52526966d613f4c741.png] 

5) T sits to the immediate right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/588e14bb5c7e84ded5d28fc0ca819647f75c294979aead18e3fe88e3236699be.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, W sits at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4faff6ed8bff45a01735a14c7eec4ad150f5e99858616c82c6864e3537799d47.png]
questions.solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure are shown below:

1) Number of triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2

= [2 × (1 + 2)] ÷ 2

= [2 × 3] ÷ 2

= 6 ÷ 2

= 3

Here, there are 2 same types of partitioned triangles as marked, therefore total number of triangles will be: → 3 × 2 = 6

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af24b0bc2e7e810ce3cd158eb46af5d35d2e7569d91ce7a6238c3fd8184ca36e.png] 

2) Number of triangles = Number of parts × Number of diagonals

= 4 × 2 ⇒ 8

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5af6175f0de977008533c83685f6197504116dc839fef23513f1d8db64d2bf9a.png] 

Thus, as marked there are a total of (6 + 8) = 14 triangles in the given figure.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
